title: Multi-Level Market Making with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.18195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce a reinforcement learning framework for market making in a limit order book. Our algorithm aims to maximize trading revenue by dynamically submitting market and limit orders of varying sizes across multiple price levels while controlling inventory size. We use multivariate logistic-normal distributions to model order allocations and employ a deep-set encoder to aggregate features from variable-length order sets into a fixed-dimensional latent representation. Additionally, we incorporate potential-based reward shaping to accelerate learning without altering the optimal policy. We illustrate the performance of the method in three simulated market environments consisting of noise traders who submit random trades, tactical traders who respond to instantaneous volume imbalance, and strategic traders who trade in the direction of an exponentially weighted volume imbalance signal.

translated_title: 基于强化学习的多层级做市策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18195v1 公告类型：新 摘要：我们提出了一种用于限价订单簿中做市的强化学习框架。我们的算法旨在通过动态地在多个价格层级提交不同规模的市场订单和限价订单，同时控制库存规模，以最大化交易收益。我们使用多元逻辑正态分布来建模订单分配，并采用深度集编码器将可变长度订单集合中的特征聚合为固定维度的潜在表示。此外，我们引入了基于势能的奖励塑形技术，以在不改变最优策略的情况下加速学习。我们在三个模拟市场环境中展示了该方法的性能，这些环境包括提交随机交易的噪声交易者、对瞬时成交量失衡做出反应的战术交易者，以及沿指数加权成交量失衡信号方向交易的战略交易者。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于强化学习的多层级做市框架，通过深度集编码器和多元逻辑正态分布优化订单分配，并利用势能奖励塑形提升学习效率，在多种模拟市场环境中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning framework for multi-level market making, using deep-set encoders and multivariate logistic-normal distributions for order allocation, enhanced by potential-based reward shaping to accelerate learning, and validated across diverse simulated market environments.
